From the owner
Discover where every celebration feels closer at Aakar Lords Inn Saputara. 🌿🎉 From vibrant cultural performances and joyful celebrations to peaceful monsoon mornings surrounded by lush green landscapes, Saputara offers something special for every kind of getaway. At Aakar Lords Inn, enjoy a comfortable stay while experiencing the natural beauty, rich culture, and festive spirit of Gujarat’s only hill station. Whether you're planning a family vacation, a cultural escape, a weekend retreat, or a refreshing monsoon holiday, Aakar Lords Inn offers comfortable accommodations, modern amenities, delicious dining, and warm hospitality for a memorable stay. Experience the best of Saputara with Aakar Lords Inn and make every celebration, every journey, and every moment feel closer. 🌧️🌿✨
